messages:
samir: Quick check — HSM attestation for SOC2: where are we on vendor cert + signed attestation? Need final artifact for the auditors by 2026-05-01. Who's driving vendor follow-up and key policy snapshot?

lina: I uploaded the attestation draft and an evidence map to Drive: https://drive.google.com/attestations/rdw-hsm-draft (internal only). I still need the vendor signature & cert chain. :memo:

jordan: Infra update — auditlog pipeline core work is finished, PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auditlog/pull/234. Schema changes are minimal but require review. We can start shipping logs to secure-bucket once the key policy is approved and we get a staging deploy green.

morgan: ping @jordan for PR review — left comments about batching and a small rename. If schema changes land we need to regenerate redact rules (linked in the PR).

infra-bot: deploy: auditlog-worker v1.3.2 -> staging succeeded (1865014000) :white_check_mark:

jordan: Thanks infra-bot. @morgan noted, I'll address comments tonight and aim to merge tomorrow AM. On the key policy: do you want infra to open the ticket for security review or should security create it?

taylor: Security here — I'll own the policy approval. @jordan please attach the key policy diff + IAM matrix to the ticket. Also add the HSM serial number & vendor cert chain to the evidence folder once available. :eyes:

lina: Added vendor contact to the sheet: vendor+attest@example.com and just emailed them requesting signed attestation + cert chain (cc @taylor). Vendor asked for our CSR timeline; I told them EOD Friday.

samir: For audit readiness I'll compile a minimal deliverables list: (1) signed attestation from vendor, (2) key policy snapshot (json), (3) auditlog retention config and lifecycle, (4) evidence map link, (5) PR link for pipeline. Anything missing?

taylor: That's good. Also include the HSM firmware/serial evidence and the KMS rotation policy history (last 12 months). I'll export keypolicy.json into the evidence folder after review.

lina: FYI I pasted a snippet for S3 lifecycle we plan to apply (10y retention):
```
PUT /?lifecycle-config
{
  "Rules": [{"ID":"audit-logs","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":3650}}]
}
```
I'll attach the exact CLI command in the evidence sheet.

morgan: :thumbsup: sounds good. One more ask — can we mark an owner for the canary rollout window? We should avoid peak traffic for cutting over logs.

jordan: I'll own the canary schedule. Proposing: staging -> small corp-canary next Tue 02:00-04:00 PT, then full roll Thursday night if green.

samir: Perfect. I'll add these milestones to the SOC2 runbook and tag dependencies (infra -> merge PR, security -> approve policy, vendor -> signed attestation). I'll follow up in the audit thread with deadlines. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
